# ColdCaseIndex (coldcaseindex.com)

## About
ColdCaseIndex is a searchable database of 780 documented cold cases and historic
crimes: unsolved homicides, missing persons, unidentified victims, serial
murders, and solved cases of historical significance. Coverage spans all 50 US
states, the District of Columbia and other countries.

Each entry has: name, case type, status (Unsolved, Partially Solved, Identified,
Arrest Made, Pending Trial, Wanted, Conviction, Solved, No Conviction, Ruled
Suicide), date, location, a summary, a dated timeline and its sources.
People who have not been convicted are presumed innocent.

## Data
- Full dataset: https://coldcaseindex.com/data/cases.json
  (JSON array; id, name, type, status, year, date, state, city, country, age,
  gender, summary, lastSeen, tags, narrative, timeline, sources)
- Compact index: https://coldcaseindex.com/data/cases-index.json
- Change log, one entry per case and day: https://coldcaseindex.com/data/changelog.json
- US homicide clearance statistics, 1965 to 2024, by state and year:
  https://coldcaseindex.com/data/us-homicide-stats.json
  (Murder Accountability Project analysis of FBI data, via Project: Cold Case)

## URLs
- Homepage and search: https://coldcaseindex.com/
- Case pages: https://coldcaseindex.com/cases/{case-id}/
- By state or country: https://coldcaseindex.com/states/
- By type: https://coldcaseindex.com/types/
- By decade: https://coldcaseindex.com/decades/
- By theme (genetic genealogy, college students, civil rights era, disputed convictions, Doe cases, body never found): https://coldcaseindex.com/themes/
- By city (cities with several cases): https://coldcaseindex.com/cities/
- Map of US cases by city, filterable by status, type and decade: https://coldcaseindex.com/map/
- Analysis computed from the case timelines, recomputed on every build:
  how long cold cases take to solve: https://coldcaseindex.com/analysis/how-long-cold-cases-take-to-solve/
  what breaks cold cases (genetic genealogy, DNA, confessions, tips): https://coldcaseindex.com/analysis/cold-case-resolution-methods/
- Recent changes (cases added, status changes, timelines extended): https://coldcaseindex.com/updates/
- Atom feed of those changes: https://coldcaseindex.com/feed.xml
- Cases whose status can still change, with next court dates: https://coldcaseindex.com/watch/
- On this day and anniversaries by month: https://coldcaseindex.com/today/ and https://coldcaseindex.com/month/
- About and methodology: https://coldcaseindex.com/about/
- Sitemap: https://coldcaseindex.com/sitemap.xml

## Contact
Corrections, updates or removal requests: info@coldcaseindex.com
ColdCaseIndex does not collect tips. If you have information about a case,
contact the responsible police force or the FBI at tips.fbi.gov.
